svg.title: How bountyproof works
svg.desc: Radar watches the bug bounty platforms and alerts you. You approve the scope. Inside the scope guard, which blocks anything out of scope, /bountyproof:hunt runs Recon, the Hunters in parallel, the Validator, the Judge and the Writer on its own. In one real run against the demo lab, 22 leads became 17 reproduced and 16 passed. You press submit and get the payout.
svg.text: The agents hunt and prove. You approve the scope and press submit.
Numbers from one real run against the demo lab.
